calendar.rule: calendar month of GMj = ((start - 1 + j - 1) mod 12) + 1
calendar.month_order: matched by file name (Jan..Dec); see monthly_sanity_check.csv

assumptions.groundwater_method_text: Annual groundwater storage = sum of the 12 monthly groundwater values x usable fraction (fixed at the start of the season). Each growing month, irrigation need that surface water cannot meet is taken from the storage that is left; the storage is reduced by what is used. A month has no gap while the remaining storage covers its need. Once the storage is used up, the rest is gap.
assumptions.supply_definition: SWSupply + GWSupply (surface water first each month, then groundwater from the remaining annual storage); missing SW/GW cells inside the crop mask = 0
assumptions.crop_area_note: All crops share one common land mask: CropArea is mapped eligible agricultural area, not crop-specific area.
